author: ben
content_raw:
Apply
The Irish Life Experience has strict requirements to be accepted into the program, which include the following:

An application is completed by the student and student’s parent(s).
Faculty recommendations are completed.
All are submitted with a $600 deposit.
Students are notified of approval/denial within 14 days.
An additional $1,000 deposit is required by March 1.
Full payment is due by June 1.

title: ILE ambassador
author: ben
content_raw:
Our
Ambassadors
																										
Kylene B.-ILE 2019
My name is Kylene Berna and I am from Georgetown, Delaware.  I am currently studying at La Roche University in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.  I am a motivated student working toward a Bachelor of Science degree in Interior Design.  I possess skills involving organization, responsibility, and good communication.  I have proven successful working in fast-paced and collaborative settings.  Most of my hobbies include anything to do with art.  I also enjoy spending time with my family and friends, listening to music, watching movies, and I have a strong passion for traveling.  
The Irish Life Experience is an amazing life-changing experience.  This program gives students the opportunity to not only travel, but to learn and engage in the Irish culture, create a long-term family, friend relationships with others, and explore the magical green lands of Ireland.  Words can not describe this journey, but it is truly inspiring.  I went on the 2019 Irish Life Experience and I absolutely fell in love with Ireland.  I felt that this was my home away from home and the program fulfilled my dreams and more.  Today I even have a Celtic tattoo, along with my first name in Gaelic.  I have also taken the opportunity to continue my journey in Ireland with the Irish Life Experience by becoming a Junior Counselor for the summer of 2022.  I can’t wait to meet everyone and travel with this special program again.  Please reach out to me with any questions you might have.  
Visit on Facebook»
E-Mail»kylene21berna@gmail.com
			
						Go Back

title: Ambassadors Testimonal
author: tharrison
content_raw:
Our
Ambassadors
																														
Johanna B.-ILE 2015
Hello, I’m Johanna!
I live in a small town just south of Chicago and I am about to start my last year of high school.  Ireland and Irish culture has always been a huge part of my life, and I was lucky enough to receive a scholarship to go on the ILE, this past summer.  The ILE was one of the best experiences of my life and I will never forget it.  I was a bit nervous before I left, but once I got there, everyone was so kind and welcoming, especially the ILE Staff. Once you get to Logan Airport, you already start making friendships for life.  Ireland is so beautiful and traveling with the ILE really makes it so much more special.  Ireland was like a piece of heaven on earth.  I could talk about the ILE all day if you wanted me to! 
So I encourage you to join the ILE before it is too late and make so many beautiful memories like I did!
Visit on Facebook»
E-Mail»bastas2234@aol.com
			
						Go Back

title: About Template
author: ile
content_raw:
What you need to know
About Our Landmark Team
trust in experience
Our Mission
Our mission at Landmark Educational Tours is customizing and personalizing safe and elite educational travel experiences for all, with passion, transparency and ingenuity, to landmarks worldwide. 
 & Our Vision
Landmark Educational Tours brings creative and inclusive educational travel experiences to communities by helping group travelers fulfill their bucket list aspirations. 
Our passion for Travel is Indescribable 
The triple E, an exceptional educational experience. At Landmark Educational Tours our goal is to provide group tours an outstanding level of our highest quality educational service. 
Landmark Educational Tours is employee-owned and operated by travelers who have a passion to help others explore the world’s landmarks. Our values, vision, and mission are rooted in the hospitality industry. We invite all ages of travelers to embark to landmarks around the world with Landmark Educational Tours!
															
			Michaela Ruffino, Managing Director
															
															
															
																														
Exceptional Landmark Leaders 
let’s start, Embark with landmark!
			
						Request a quote
					
The people Behind the scenes
Our Landmark Team
Our team of dedicated travel enthusiasts is composed of many years within the hospitality industry. 
																														
Managing Director
Michaela Ruffino
Residing in Rhode Island, raised in Minooka, IL. Michaela is an experienced leader with a demonstrated history of working within the hospitality industry. She holds a strong portfolio of travel knowledge; including her bachelor’s degree focused in Travel and Tourism Hospitality Management from Johnson & Wales University. 
“My current bucket list aspirations include Egypt, Morocco, Switzerland, and Greece!” 
																														
Finance Director
GERARDO BARRERA
Gerardo Barrera began his journey in the travel Industry 20+ years ago when he joined as a Finance Director for StudentCity.com. He gradually became the Chief Financial Officer of the parent company, TUI Education North America which portfolio includes Brightspark, Educational Tours, Jumpstreet, Educatours, Travel Adventures and New Horizons.  Now, Gerardo lives in Boston with his wife and two sons. He also is the Co-Founder of Go Blue Tours, Juniper Tours and Landmark Educational Tours.
																														
Landmark Tour Specialist 
SaRah Hessasta
“‘I am a graduate from Johnson & Wales University, and a cold brew enthusiast who loves taking long walks anywhere. A few of  my bucket list trips include a cross-country road trip throughout the U.S., and Asia (specifically Bhutan, Korea, and Japan!). “
																
															
LEAD Of Marketing
Karissa Chandler
		COMING SOON 
																
															
LEAD Of Operations
Ericka Montano
		Ericka is our Director of Operations at Landmark Educational Tours. She has never stopped learning and is about to graduate from Tourism Business Administration. Ericka is fully bilingual and has more than 20 years of experience working in operations activities such as group management, financial management, contract management, logistics, and customer service. Her experience working with large corporations such as TUI and First Choice has given her the knowledge and skills to help improve our product. Ericka’s signature is her strong service philosophy and focuses on achieving all aspects of our elite service.
																														
Systems Expert
Edwin Yip
Edwin Yip has decades of commerce system experience. Most recent is his 15 years of building systems for the travel industry. This experience began with First Choice in the United Kingdom which merged with TUI Travel PLC which became the largest tour operator in the world with over 60 thousand employees.  While as the Director of Application Development at TUI Student Travel he worked with Brightspark , Jumpstreet, Education Tours,  and other student brands of the company in building out their commerce platforms.
 
In addition to travel systems, he also has deep experience in ecommerce and financial services systems. This combination of expertise allows the creation of highly available and robust commerce systems.

author: tharrison
content_raw:
Self Drive Tour ofIreland 
Dublin – Kilkenny – Dingle – Galway
			
						Request a Quote
					
Self Drive Tour of Ireland
Welcome to Ireland
Highlights
Your Self Drive Tour of Ireland is the perfect introductory tour of the Emerald Isle. Take the road to where ever it may take you.
Above all, consult with your Destination Specialist. We will ensure that the highlights of your trip are booked in advance so you won’t miss out on the fun!  Lots of time at leisure will be built in so you can explore on your own, and at your own pace. Let the journey guide you.
Read more about why we love a Self Drive Tour of Ireland.
Make it Yours

Accommodation – Ireland offers a wide range of accommodation styles including boutique hotels, charming B&B’s, and luxurious castle hotels.  Juniper will select where you stay based on your preferences.
Transportation – All of the dots will be connected based on your preferences and budget.  Airport transfers, car rentals, train passes, even private chauffeurs!
Day tours and entrance tickets – pre-scheduled tours and experiences for a seamless and enriching travel experience!

															
			
						Request a Quote
					
Self Drive Tour of Ireland Daily Itinerary
			
						Day 1
					
			
						Day 2
					
			
						Day 3
					
			
						Day 4
					
			
						Day 5
					
			
						Day 6
					
			
						Day 7
					
			
						Day 8
					
			
						Day 9
					
			
						Day 1-3
					
			
						Day 4-6
					
			
						Day 7-9
					
Day 1: Arrive in Dublin
Immerse yourself in the Irish culture today with an Irish Food Tour or a Guinness Factory Tour. We also recommend spending your evening relaxing at a local pub taking in the beautiful country.
Overnight in Dublin
Day 2: Dublin
Dublin is a small capital but has numerous amounts of history and sights to see. Spend today sightseeing with a historical walking tour or a cruise down River Liffey. Your destination specialist can help you finalize your itinerary to create the perfect experience.
Overnight in Dublin
Day 3: Dublin to Kilkenny
After breakfast today you will check out of your Dublin hotel and take a short taxi ride to your car rental agency (taxi fare not included).
Once you’ve collected your car you will set out into the Irish countryside!  Your first stop will be the elegant Powerscourt Estate to explore its lush grounds and impressive manor.  Weather permitting, you may decide to take a stroll to the Powerscourt Waterfall, the highest in Ireland.
As you continue to Kilkenny be sure to drive through the Wicklow Mountains for a scenic route.
Overnight in Kilkenny
Day 4: Kilkenny
Explore the famous marble-city. Take a privately guided tour of the Kilkenny Castle. Spend your afternoon sightseeing on your own or hire a private guide to take you through this historic town.
Overnight in Kilkenny
Day 5: Kilkenny to Dingle
Check out of your Kilkenny hotel and head west to Dingle.  Along the way, you’ll have lots of opportunities for sightseeing and touring.  Blarney Castle, the Rock of Cashel, the original Jameson Distillery, and more are all along the way.  Your Destination Specialist can help you organize your time!
Overnight in Dingle
Day 6: Dingle
Today is a full day to explore all that Dingle has to offer! 
Take your time in the morning to drive Dingle’s famous circular route called the Slea Head Drive, visit the Dingle Distillery for a tour and tasting of its whiskey and award-winning gin, take an excursion out on the water.  Your Destination Specialist can help you decide the best options for you and your travel party.
Overnight in Dingle
Day 7: Dingle to Galway
After breakfast and get an early start on the day with a road trip to the Cliffs of Moher. Plan to take a comfort break in Adare. Once at the Cliffs of Moher take a short walk close to the edge of the cliff and take in some breathtaking views. You have the option of taking a walk along the cliffs which can take one person anywhere from one to two hours to complete. If you would rather not walk, perhaps take in the views from below as well with a ferry ride. Once finished head to your next stop, Galway. 
Overnight in Galway
Day 8: Galway
Enjoy a full day in County Galway at your leisure.
Consider exploring north of Galway town and visiting the Connemara Mountains and the charming Kylemore Abbey tucked into its hills.  Or, stay in Galway itself and enjoy the lively cafes, shops, and coastline.
Overnight in Galway
Day 9: Depart for Home
After breakfast this morning you will check out of your Galway hotel and head south to the Shannon Airport.  Leave your rental car with the agency and prepare to say “Farewell!” to the Emerald Isle.
Get Ready to Travel!

										Private, Guided Castle Tour

										Irish Food Tour
									

										River Liffey Tour
									

										 Guided Museum Tours
									

										Entrance to Powerscourt Estate
									

			
						Request a Quote
					
Explore More Ireland Itineraries
Why We Love this Tour
Your Self Drive Tour of Ireland is the perfect introductory tour of the Emerald Isle.  It offers the freedom and flexibility of a chauffeured experience with a price point closer to a group guided tour. You and your loved ones can have the best of Ireland!
We love this itinerary because it allows you to see the highlights of Ireland as a first-time visitor. Or you can relive the best of Ireland if you’ve been before.  By staying in Dublin, swinging down to Kilkenny, then continuing to the beloved County Kerry you’ll have many sightseeing and touring opportunities.
Why We Love Dublin
Ireland’s capital city of Dublin blends modern amenities with charming historic neighborhoods. A flourishing food scene for everyone to enjoy. Explore the iconic sites such as the Guinness Storehouse, the Glasnevin Cemetery, and the Kilmainham Gaol.  Enjoy a pint and live music in a pub in the famous Temple Bar neighborhood. Join a walking tour about the Easter Rising or Ireland’s rich literature, or take a day trip up to Belfast for a bit of Northern Ireland.
Why We Love Kilkenny 
Kilkenny is one of Ireland’s oldest cities, dating as far back as the 6th century.  On the way there take some time to hike the stunning Wicklow Mountains. Then visit Powerscourt Estate to see the impressive house and manicured gardens.
Why We Love Country Kerry
County Kerry is ideal for those partaking in a self-drive tour of Ireland.  The rambling roadways of County Kerry cut through patchwork fields. Drive alongside the dramatic and rocky coastline. It’s home to some of the most striking castle ruins and charming villages Ireland has to offer.Make this independent adventure yours!  
Nights can be added or reduced, your route can be changed. Tours and activity options can be selected based on your interests and purpose of travel.  Having a rental car allows you to visit the pockets of Ireland that the train doesn’t reach. All of this without the expense of constraints of a private chauffeur.  Come and go as you please. You never know what you’ll discover when you’re exploring this special country at your own pace!
Your Destination Specialist knows Ireland and will take the time to learn what’s important to you.  Your itinerary will be designed just for you, to make the most of your time and experience in the Emerald Isle!

<script>
function ready(callback){
    // in case the document is already rendered
    if (document.readyState!='loading') callback();
    // modern browsers
    else if (document.addEventListener) document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', callback);
    // IE <= 8
    else document.attachEvent('onreadystatechange', function(){
        if (document.readyState=='complete') callback();
    });
}

ready(function(){
    
    var form = document.getElementById('__bwco__formsearch');

    if (form.attachEvent) {
        form.attachEvent("submit", processForm);
    } else {
        form.addEventListener("submit", processForm);
    }
       
    
	function processForm(e) {
		if (e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();

		/* change form method if required */
		 form.method = 'POST'; 
		/* do what you want with the form */
			form.action='https://secure.gobluetours.com/booking/search';
			form.submit();

	 
		
		// You must return false to prevent the default form behavior
		return false;
	}
    
});
    
</script>

<script>
	
	  jQuery('#__bwco__return_date').change(function(){
	
		var day1 = new Date(jQuery('#__bwco__depart_date').val());
		var day2 = new Date(jQuery('#__bwco__return_date').val());
		
		var difference= Math.abs(day2-day1);
        days = difference/(1000 * 3600 * 24)
		jQuery('#__bwco__nights').val(days);
	
	});
	
	jQuery('#__bwco__depart_date').change(function(){
	
		var day1 = new Date(jQuery('#__bwco__depart_date').val());
		var day2 = new Date(jQuery('#__bwco__return_date').val());

		var difference= Math.abs(day2-day1);
        days = difference/(1000 * 3600 * 24)
		jQuery('#__bwco__nights').val(days);
	
	});
	
	jQuery('#__bwco__nights').change(function(){
	
	var depart_date_original = jQuery('#__bwco__depart_date').val();
	var nights = parseInt(jQuery('#__bwco__nights').val());
	var day1 = new Date(depart_date_original);
	day1.setUTCHours(0,0,0,0);
 
	day1.setUTCDate(parseInt(day1.getUTCDate()) + nights);
	
	var month= parseInt(day1.getUTCMonth())+1;
	var day = day1.getUTCDate();
	var year = day1.getUTCFullYear();

	if (month < 10){
		month = '0' + month;
	}

	if (day < 10){
		day = '0' + day;
	}

	var newday = year+'-'+month+'-'+day;
	jQuery('#__bwco__return_date').val(newday);
	
	});
	

</script>
